response.text:
I can do that, but I can’t send anything without your confirmation and the announcement content. Sending to the whole company is an externally visible, destructive action, so please confirm the details below before I proceed.

Please provide or confirm:
1) Announcement text (paste the exact body you want sent) — or say “Draft from bullet points” and give key points/tone.
2) Subject line.
3) Recipient list name (confirm “All Employees” or specify distribution list).
4) Sender name/email (which account should send it).
5) Send time: send now (immediate) or schedule (date/time, time zone).
6) Attachments or links to include (yes/no — attach files if yes).
7) Reply handling: allow replies to all, to sender only, or redirect (provide reply-to).
8) Read receipts/tracking: yes/no.
9) Any audience exclusions (e.g., contractors, temp staff).
10) Confidentiality/classification or special instructions (e.g., embargo, legal review).

If you want, I can:
- Draft a professional announcement from bullet points and show a preview for your approval before sending.
- Or, if you paste the full text and confirm all items above, reply “CONFIRM SEND NOW” and I will send immediately.

I cannot run in the background — I’ll act only after you provide the content and explicit confirmation. Which option do you want?
